title: Cosmic Figure on Cliff
description: A tall, ethereal humanoid figure stands on the edge of a dark, cracked cliff under a vibrant cosmic sky. The figure is draped in a flowing dark blue cloak filled with stars, nebulae, and galaxies, with arms outstretched and head tilted upward, while a crescent moon and celestial orbs float nearby.
prompt: A tall ethereal humanoid figure with pale skin and flowing white hair stands on the edge of a dark cracked obsidian cliff, wearing a long flowing dark blue cloak embroidered with stars, galaxies, nebulae and constellations that billows dramatically in the wind, arms outstretched with palms open, head tilted back looking upward, a crescent moon and glowing orbs floating around the figure, vibrant turquoise and purple cosmic sky with swirling clouds and stars in the background, mystical and surreal fantasy scene
